methodDetails.description: Reassigned last 32 sorted web/tests files. Every file parsed with the installed rolldown 1.2.15 TypeScript/TSX/JS AST parser, every AST traversed, every extracted test title and full expect matcher expression reviewed, and local import resolution checked. High-risk fixture source was additionally read in full for the 16 files listed in manualSemanticFiles. The other 16 files received complete structural and assertion-contract review, not full line-by-line fixture-source review. Reviewed original receipts and not-sent boundaries, stale owner and A-to-B-to-A response fencing, remote pairing secret lifetime, realtime media cleanup, model configuration consent, file/worktree exact revision proof, bounded rendering and resource polling.
limitations: No full test suites or browser fixtures were executed.
AST and assertion-contract review checks source syntax and intended behavior; it is not equivalent to executing those behaviors or to a full manual fixture read for contractOnlyFiles.
No personal credentials, paid inference or remote host/deployment operations were accessed.
